# What Does a Business Analyst Earn in Australia in 2026?
SEEK puts the average business analyst salary in Australia at $110,000 to $130,000 a year (September 2026). Junior BAs typically start around $70,000 to $90,000, senior BAs earn $120,000 to $150,000 and lead roles reach $180,000+.

## Business Analyst Salary Overview (2026)
The average Business Analyst salary in Australia is **$105,000 per year.**

## AI Business Analyst Salary: What the Emerging Specialisation Pays in 2026
The senior business analyst salary range in Australia sits between $120,000 and $150,000 per year for permanent roles, with contractors pushing well past $200,000 annually at $800 to $1,000 per day.

With 266+ graduates and a combined salary pool of $30.3 million, the average salary sits at $120,000.

## What the "Average Business Analyst Salary" Figure Actually Means
The average Business Analyst salary in Australia is cited as $105,000 almost everywhere you look, and that number is accurate in the broadest sense.

Entry-level BAs in Australia start between $70,000 and $90,000.
